name: CID Tuning Dataset Builder
description: Build a stratified CID tuning CSV (and optional test-remain set) from PubTator gold dev.txt.

runner_id.description: Target runner folder under tests/, default wf_cid_re_llm_linear.

source.description: PubTator gold source file, default dev.txt.

write_test_remain.description: Also write remaining docs as test CSV, default true.

mirror_ner.description: Mirror outputs to wf_cid_ner_llm_eval, default true.
